_comment: THE OFFICIAL @atwe ACCOUNT ALREADY EXISTS ON EVERY DATABASE. Do not try to
create it. server.js creates it itself on every boot (ensureOfficialAccount)
so the platform can post as itself from day one, so add-account will always
and correctly REFUSE it as an existing username.
To let somebody sign in as it in BETA, give the existing account a password:
That command takes no username. It only ever acts on the app's own account,
and it refuses unless every identity check proves the row is the one the app
created: the username, the no-reply+atwe@atwe.internal address, the name, the
business account type, not is_demo, and no admin rights of any kind.
This file is OPTIONAL there. Passing it only makes the command check that the
file describes @atwe as an ordinary member; nothing in it is ever written.
NOTE on --claim-reserved: @atwe is on the reserved list in routes.js, but the
app DELETES that reservation the moment it creates the account, so on any
database the beta app has booted against the flag is neither needed nor used.
PUBLIC PROFILE TEXT ONLY. There is deliberately no password field, and the
tool REFUSES a file carrying password / passwordHash / secret / token /
stripe / oauth / totp / session / isAdmin or any other credential. The
password comes from BETA_SEED_PASSWORD or a hidden prompt.
